n64f91f9f82.headline: Senegal Wants to Focus on Its Debt in the 2025 Revised Finance Law
n64f91f9f82.summary: Senegalese lawmakers were summoned to a plenary session on 28 June 2025 to examine the draft revised 2025 finance law. The government wants to focus the revision on its debt.
n64f91f9f82.why: Senegal's public debt position and budget revisions are closely watched by investors and creditors, particularly given its IMF engagement.
